name: fetch_page
description: Fetch a public URL and get its content only if it really loaded. Checks for block pages, CAPTCHAs, login walls and empty JavaScript shells, and retries through other routes (including a headless browser) automatically. Billed only on success. Returns markdown by default.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.desc: markdown (default, main content), html (raw page), rendered (always use a browser)

arguments.name: expect_text
arguments.desc: Text that must appear on the page for it to count as loaded, e.g. a product name

arguments.name: max_cost
arguments.desc: Most credits to pay: 1 static only, 2 (default) allows a browser, 10-25 allows premium unblocking

name: domain_reliability
description: Pass rates per route (plain HTTP, browser, providers) for a domain over the last 30 days, from real verified fetches. Free, no key needed.
